name: more-enemies
title: More Enemies
author: TheEckelmonster
description:
Simple idea of just having more enemies, with larger and/or more enemy attack groups.

Clones enemies and enemy unit groups, as well as exposes several enemy and spawner settings; all configurable from within the game.

Comes with five preset difficulties: Easy(0.1), Vanilla(1), Vanilla+(1.75), Hard(4), and Insanity(11). Each added setting can be configured independently of the selected difficulty to personal taste.
